sloka: कच्चित् सर्वाणि दुर्गाणि धनधान्यायुधोदकै: ।यन्त्रैश्च परिपूर्णानि तथा शिल्पिधनुर्द्धरै ॥ २.१००.५४॥
transliteration: kaccit sarvāṇi durgāṇi dhanadhānyāyudhodakai: ।yantraiśca paripūrṇāni tathā śilpidhanurddharai ॥ 2.100.54॥

translations.english: O Bharata, I trust, your revenues are abundant and expenditure much less. I trust you do not give away your treasure to undeserving persons.
